Class EgradxObservabilityProperties.Shipping

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.observability.config.EgradxObservabilityProperties.Shipping
Enclosing class:
EgradxObservabilityProperties
public static class EgradxObservabilityProperties.Shipping extends Object
egradx.observability.logging.shipping.*: every log line sent to an EgradxLogSink (with egradx-platform-events, over the events transport). Off by default.
